noah: Quick RFC follow-up: we need to finalize the admission -> scheduler degrade handshake and cross-region budget semantics.

priya: Short summary of current options?

noah: 1) central decisions (admission decides allow/degrade/reject). 2) local decisions (scheduler uses a soft hint and acts). 3) hybrid: admission returns a small, cacheable blob (decision + budget + generation) and schedulers do short-lived smoothing.

toni: Hybrid seems best tradeoff. Central for hard rejects, local for latency-sensitive smoothing.

sam: Agree. Key for hybrid: clear fields and expiry to bound cross-node overspend. Also region-aware budgets to avoid west/eu double-spend.

noah: API sketch (tiny):

```
POST /admission/check
{ "tenant": "t-99", "tokens": 256, "ctx": {"region":"us-west-2"} }
---
{ "decision":"allow|degrade|reject", "budget":64, "budget_window_s":10, "generation":"g-123", "expiry_s":5, "model_variant_hint":["rwd/opt-2.7b-8bit"] }
```

priya: If admission is down, what's fallback? permissive probation or conservative reject?

toni: Make it tenant-configurable. Default: permissive for dev tenants, conservative for enterprise. Also include risk_score in blob so schedulers pick fallback automatically.

sam: Telemetry must include decision_origin={central|local}, generation, chosen_variant, enforcement_outcome. Ops needs low-cardinality tags but enough to debug.

ops-bot: Filed INFRA-980 for metrics schema. Suggest minimal tags: tenant, region, decision_origin, generation.

noah: One more: sign the blob (HMAC) so schedulers trust cached blobs without hitting admission every time. Include expiry_s to limit replay.

priya: Timeline: 2w for blob + cache + metrics, 6w for generation_id, region budgets, smoothing lib, model downgrade path.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: admission/feature/degrade-blob -> staging (sha: a1b2c3).

noah: I'll update the RFC with the tiny API sample and owners. If no objections to region-scoped budgets, we'll go ahead.

toni: no objections.

sam: +1

noah: Thanks all.
